subject: اللغة الإنجليزية
lesson: Types of reading and reading speeds; calculating words per minute
outcomes: Know the four types of reading and their speeds
Change seconds into decimals of a minute

tf.s: Close reading is slower than 100 words per minute.
tf.why: Yes, close reading is the slowest type.

tf.s: Skimming is the slowest type of reading.
tf.why: Skimming is the fastest, above 400 wpm.

tf.s: Casual reading of newspapers and magazines is about 250–400 wpm.
tf.why: Right, we read these quickly and informally.
Yes, academic texts need careful but steady reading.

tf.s: We read a contract and a magazine at the same speed.
tf.why: We read different texts at different speeds.

tf.s: Reading 300 words in 2 minutes is 150 wpm.
Practising regularly can help you read faster.

boxes.q: Which type of reading is above 400 wpm?
Which type of reading do we use for newspapers and magazines?
boxes.why: Casual reading is quick and informal.

boxes.q: To find reading speed, you divide the number of words by...
Which type of reading is the slowest?
What is one way to improve reading speed?
15 seconds is what part of a minute?

mcq.q: Close reading is below how many words per minute?
What is the formula for reading speed?
mcq.why: Divide the words by the time in minutes.

mcq.q: Which texts do we usually read with casual reading?
mcq.why: Casual reading is for informal texts.

mcq.q: In the example, 546 words in 3 minutes 25 seconds is about...
Hamad read 450 words in 3 minutes. What is his speed?
Laila read 700 words in 3 minutes 30 seconds. What is her speed?
A student looks quickly through an article at 450 wpm to get the main idea. What is this?
mcq.why: Above 400 wpm for the main idea is skimming.

mcq.q: Why do university students need to read fast?
mcq.why: Essays, research and exams need a lot of reading.

mcq.q: Why do we read a contract more slowly than a magazine?
o: Every detail in a contract is important

mcq.q: Why must you change seconds into decimals before calculating?
o: Because the formula divides by minutes
Because seconds are not real time
Because it makes the answer bigger
Because you must count the words twice
mcq.why: Time must be in minutes, so seconds become part of a minute.
